fusions.name: Full-Weight Touchdown
fusions.desc: Lands on every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 30 damage, ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Wing Swat
fusions.desc: A heavy wing swat deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Puffed-Up Bulk
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Ponderous Takeoff
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
